text:
leah_pm: Quick thread: last-mile GA gating for Edge-Optimized. We need concrete owners for SLA text, pricing examples, docs quickstart, monitoring runbook, and escalation matrix. Can owners confirm availability?

 tom_eng: I can take infra/autoscale validation. Question on SLA calc windowuse rolling 5m for alerts, 1h for SLA measurement?

 nina_fin: I'll own pricing examples + sample invoices. Need expected avg tokens and qps per tier to model.

 carmen_docs: I'll draft quickstart and migration notes once SLA wording is approved. Need approved API examples for snippets.

 raj_sre: I'll own dashboards and runbook. Proposed alert levels: warning at p95>150ms, page at p95>220ms for 10m, and page on error rate>1% for 5m. Runbook must include rollback and customer comms template.

 legal-bot: Reminder: SLA language must define "normal operating conditions" and maintenance windows; legal review required for any service-credit language.

 tom_eng: Agreed on windows: use 5m rolling for realtime alerts, 1h for hourly SLA, and 30-day aggregate for contracts. We'll tag latency by payload-size bucket (<=1KB, 1-10KB, >10KB).

 nina_fin: Pricing lanes proposal: Reserved (monthly commit), OnDemandBurst (pay-per-use with burst cap), Pilot blended tier. I'll attach sample numbers by EOD. Thinking service-credit formula tied to monthly p95 and uptime.

 carmen_docs: Draft SLA blurb for public docs: "Redwood Edge-Optimized aims to maintain p95 latency <= 150ms for <=1KB payloads under normal operating conditions. Eligible customers may receive service credits if contractual targets are missed." Will PR for review.

 raj_sre: Runbook snippet to include:
- If p95>220ms for 10m -> page infra-oncall
- If error rate>1% for 5m -> declare Sev1, page incident commander + comms
- If GPU util>85% and queue growing -> trigger emergency-burst scale or traffic-shed

 leah_pm: Owners recap: Pricing+invoices -> nina_fin (24h), SLA wording + contract stub -> nina_fin + legal (48h), Docs quickstart+snippets -> carmen_docs (48h), Monitoring+runbooks+escalation -> raj_sre (48h), Autoscale validation -> tom_eng (48h).

 deploy-bot: Canary rollout status: stage 2/3 passed, 5% traffic in us-west, no errors observed.

 tom_eng: Risk: tail latency on long-decode models under high batch depth. Mitigation: prefix caching + cap batch depth for edge pools. I'll run a focused soak and post results.

 nina_fin: Will propose service-credit tiers and sample invoice lines (credits per missed SLA bucket) in my draft.

 carmen_docs: Please CC sales-eng and solutions for migration notes. I'll include an "At GA: what to expect" section for customers.

 leah_pm: Final sign-off meeting Fri 10:00 PT. Please post PR links here before noon Fri. If you can't meet owners' deadlines, flag now.
